title: Legal quarantine + temporary version pin flow for flagged model uploads
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: We continue to see model uploads where license metadata is ambiguous or model weights are marked as restricted/encumbered. Currently these end up either being blocked outright or allowed with ad-hoc manual reviews, which causes long delays and inconsistent outcomes. This ticket proposes a deterministic "legal quarantine" workflow with a temporary version pin and clear author remediation steps so that models can be surfaced in the catalog in a safe, auditable way while legal/compliance completes a review.

Goals:
- Provide a short-lived automated quarantine state for new model uploads that fail automated license/weights checks.
- Create a temporary pin/version status so downstream serving (hosted + dedicated) is protected from automatic rollout until the model is cleared.
- Surface clear remediation steps and required artifacts to the uploader (license file, weight provenance, S3 hash, third-party attestations).
- Produce inbound telemetry for Compliance to prioritize high-risk items and capture audit trail for SOC/Legal.

Scope:
- UI flows in the model upload wizard and model detail page for quarantined models.
- Backend state machine: allowed -> quarantined -> cleared/rejected. Quarantine TTL (default 14 days) with auto-escalation.
- Temporary pin metadata that prevents automatic releases/rollouts and flags the model in the public catalog as "Under review" for non-admin views.
- Notifications: email/slack to uploader, Slack to Compliance team channel, optional SSO escalation.
- Admin console actions: clear, reject, request-more-info, extend-quarantine, and audit log entries for each action.

Out-of-scope for now: deep legal policy changes, paid support workflow, escrow mechanics (handled by separate PM ticket).

Acceptance criteria (high level):
- New uploads that fail any of the automated checks (license mismatch, missing license file, restricted weights flag) enter quarantined state with a generated ticket and TTL.
- Uploader sees precise remediation checklist and a single-click "submit evidence" flow that attaches artifacts to the quarantine ticket.
- Compliance can clear/reject in Console; clearing removes the temporary pin and publishes the model, rejecting makes the model non-public and gives a canned rejection reason.
- All state transitions produce verifiable audit entries (who, when, why) surfaced in the admin audit log and included in the model's provenance metadata.
- Quarantine telemetry (counts, mean time to clear, top failure reasons) appears in the compliance dashboard and is tagged by region & uploader-org.

Design/UX notes:
- See Figma frames: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/model-quarantine-ux (flows for uploader, compliance reviewer, admin audit).
- Minimal UX for public catalog: models under quarantine show a prominent "Under review" badge and do not appear in spotlight/featured lists.

Technical notes and trade-offs:
- Option A (preferred): Create a lightweight "quarantine" flag in the metadata store and a TTL queue (Redis stream) that triggers reminders + escalation. Pros: fast to implement, compatible with Dedicated + Private. Cons: additional state logic in serving path to respect temp pins.
- Option B: Fork model version into a staged namespace and hold publishing until clearance. Pros: stronger isolation; Cons: more infra work and duplication for storage and model artifacts (larger cost).
- We recommend Option A for initial rollout and Option B as a hardening step for enterprise customers that require artifact isolation.

Open questions: 
- Should quarantined models be accessible to tenant admins in Private deployments by default, or follow org policy? (Suggest opt-out at the tenant level)
- TTL length: default 14 days vs 7 days for faster flows. Compliance prefers 14.
- What automated heuristics should increase priority (e.g., model source from unvetted bucket, large weight files, license type = restrictive)?

Links and artifacts:
- PRD: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Legal+Quarantine+Flow
- Design: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/model-quarantine-ux
- API sketch (backend): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xyz_quarantine_api
- Related Linear tickets: PM-11789 (escrow/quarantine for encumbered weights), ENG-3473 (metadata-extractor pipeline), PM-11023 (provenance verification)
acceptance_criteria:
1) Uploads failing automated checks land in quarantined state with TTL and create a quarantine ticket.
2) Uploader shown remediation checklist and can upload artifacts.
3) Compliance reviewer can clear/reject with audit log entry.
4) Clearing removes temporary pin and model becomes publishable.
5) Dashboard shows quarantine metrics by reason and region.
steps:
1) Implement backend state machine and quarantine TTL queue (ENG).
2) Hook metadata-extractor to produce license/weights flags (ENG-3473).
3) Surface quarantine state in upload flow + model detail UI (Design + ENG).
4) Build admin actions + audit log (ENG + Security).
5) Wire notifications and compliance dashboard (PM + ENG).
6) Soft launch with internal org + pilot customers, collect MTTR and false-positive rates.
7) Iterate and add Option B (staged namespace) for enterprise.
